| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

 ## Before launch

Edit `SYNCTADA_CONFIG` at the top of `assets/js/main.js`:

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

## Booking context and analytics

Solutions pages link to `/book-demo/?for=agency|marketer|owner`; the audience is remembered for the session, shown on the booking page, and sent with the request (`audience` field).

`track()` in `main.js` pushes events to `window.dataLayer` (GTM/GA4), `gtag`, and Plausible when any is installed:

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

l## Before launch

- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.

l## Before launch

Edit `SYNCTADA_CONFIG` at the top of `assets/js/main.js`:

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

r## Before launch

Edit `SYNCTADA_CONFIG` at the top of `assets/js/main.js`:

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

## Booking context and analytics

Solutions pages link to `/book-demo/?for=agency|marketer|owner`; the audience is remembered for the session, shown on the booking page, and sent with the request (`audience` field).

`track()` in `main.js` pushes events to `window.dataLayer` (GTM/GA4), `gtag`, and Plausible when any is installed:

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

e## Before launch

Edit `SYNCTADA_CONFIG` at the top of `assets/js/main.js`:

- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

)## Before launch

Edit `SYNCTADA_CONFIG` at the top of `assets/js/main.js`:

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

## Booking context and analytics

Solutions pages link to `/book-demo/?for=agency|marketer|owner`; the audience is remembered for the session, shown on the booking page, and sent with the request (`audience` field).

`track()` in `main.js` pushes events to `window.dataLayer` (GTM/GA4), `gtag`, and Plausible when any is installed:

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

a## Before launch

Edit `SYNCTADA_CONFIG` at the top of `assets/js/main.js`:

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

## Booking context and analytics

Solutions pages link to `/book-demo/?for=agency|marketer|owner`; the audience is remembered for the session, shown on the booking page, and sent with the request (`audience` field).

`track()` in `main.js` pushes events to `window.dataLayer` (GTM/GA4), `gtag`, and Plausible when any is installed:

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

h## Before launch

Edit `SYNCTADA_CONFIG` at the top of `assets/js/main.js`:

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.

e## Before launch

Edit `SYNCTADA_CONFIG` at the top of `assets/js/main.js`:

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

- `formEndpoint`: URL that receives form submissions as JSON (Formspree, a Vercel function, a GoHighLevel webhook). Until set, forms open the visitor's email app addressed to `contactEmail`.
- `contactEmail`: confirm the mailbox exists (currently `hello@synctada.com`).
- `schedulerUrl`: booking page for direct scheduling (Calendly, GoHighLevel calendar, Cal.com). When set, `/book-demo/` becomes: details -> pick a time (prefilled name/email, visitor's time zone shown) -> optional prep questions -> confirmation. Calendly bookings are detected automatically; other schedulers rely on a "Continue" button.
- `demoDurationMinutes`: confirmed demo length (e.g. `30`). Nothing is shown until set.
- `responseWindow`: confirmed reply time for manual scheduling (e.g. `"one business day"`). Nothing is promised until set.

Also confirm audit eligibility criteria, the access the audit needs, integration availability (GoHighLevel/HubSpot, Meta/Google), and white-label scope, then reflect them in the copy. All example reports use a fictional company and are labeled **Illustrative**.

## Booking context and analytics

Solutions pages link to `/book-demo/?for=agency|marketer|owner`; the audience is remembered for the session, shown on the booking page, and sent with the request (`audience` field).

`track()` in `main.js` pushes events to `window.dataLayer` (GTM/GA4), `gtag`, and Plausible when any is installed:

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `cta_click` | Any Book a Demo link (`cta_location`, `page_path`, `audience`) |
| `demo_form_start` / `contact_form_start` | First input in a form |
| `demo_request_submitted` | Request sent (manual scheduling) |
| `demo_details_submitted` | Details entered before picking a time (scheduler) |
| `demo_time_booked` | Scheduler confirmed a booking (`confirmed_by`: scheduler or visitor) |
| `demo_prep_submitted` | Optional CRM / ad platform answers sent |
| `contact_submitted` | Contact form sent |

Attended demos should be tracked in the CRM (e.g. a GoHighLevel/HubSpot stage), not on the website.
